acceptance.census: Every registered physical node, communicator, link, session, dedicated bank and demand represented; unsupported physics explicitly identified.
acceptance.native: Actual RouterNetTopo, RSVP, resource rules, generation, swapping, measured delivery and causal classical receipts; reference failure and recovery invariants.
acceptance.orion: Every institutional ring endpoint receives end-to-end control through native SeQUeNCe classical hop source and unchanged OrionQ backend; replay/binding/persistence chains and faults.
acceptance.no_blanket_pass: Passing covered invariants does not validate the complete hybrid quantum network, certify keys or assign TRL.

parameter_mapping.banks: Virtual native router per physical node and dedicated protocol session; no accidental shared geographic memory pool.
parameter_mapping.generation: Native Barrett-Kok is an alternate experiment to OrionQ batched pair generation; rates and fidelity are not asserted equivalent.
parameter_mapping.classical: Native hop uses supplied propagation, serialization and sampled jitter; loss/timeout injected explicitly after native reception.
parameter_mapping.unsupported: TF-QKD, satellite quantum optical payload and ISL physics are retained in census, not substituted by fibre.
